extensions.scope: Brisa wedding and XV invitations only; primitives are in adjacent DESIGN.md and normative source is the Sass implementation.

motion.name: action-transition
motion.purpose: Button background and link color changes.

motion.name: paper-unfold
motion.purpose: Paper clip reveal only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Animation and transition duration under reduced motion; scrolling becomes auto.

assets.purpose: Generated shoreline opening backdrop, countdown background, and missing-cover fallback.

integration.colors: Keystatic theme.colors primary/secondary/accent/background/text map to primario/secundario/acento/fondo/texto; base defaults apply only to base palettes, preserving seasonal palettes.
integration.typography: Keystatic theme.typography heading/body override font-heading/font-body with existing font loading.
integration.opening: Native showModal dialog; opening button focus and body scroll lock; action or Escape dispatches iniciarInvitacion, opens content, then focuses hero heading and dispatches hero:ready on requestAnimationFrame.
integration.routeComponents: Preserve themeName through Basic and common bodas; coastal variants of real quince flip cards, Cartas, and maps; omit empty gallery whitespace; disable legacy scroll hiding only for Brisa and retain one authored hero.

evidence.mode: Code-led implementation; no approved external composition.
evidence.validation: Source Sass/Astro syntax, isolated components, and actual wedding/XV invitation route samples validated. Four actual-route samples have no overflow, missing visible images, or JavaScript errors. Full project Astro build remains blocked by qs require undefined.

actualRoutes.method: Actual src/pages rendered with local MDX and original components, excluding unrelated Stripe collection sync.
actualRoutes.limits: Does not verify live submissions or all content/version combinations.

components.name: Opening action
components.description: Full-width action on the opening invitation sheet. Preview demonstrates styling; native dialog and event behavior live in each event-specific Hero-brisa.jsx.
components.html: <button class="ds-brisa-open">Abrir invitación <svg width="22" height="12" viewBox="0 0 22 12" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 6h19m-5-5 5 5-5 5" stroke="currentColor"/></svg></button>

narrative.overview: A personal photograph faces an ivory invitation sheet, with deep sea ink, warm sand surfaces, fine rules, and a generated shoreline. This system belongs only to Brisa invitations.

rules.name: Palette precedence
rules.body: Base defaults retain seasonal palettes and Keystatic overrides.

dos: Do preserve native dialog focus and invitation events.
Do stack photograph before paper below 768px.
donts: Don't apply Brisa to marketing pages.
Don't add glass panels or heavy section shadows.
Don't force base colors over editor choices.
